Country loading artwork

Canada maple leaf and India Ashoka Chakra:
Extracted from the existing flag-ca.svg and flag-in.svg without changing their
paths, proportions or colors. MIT license; see flags-LICENSE.txt in this folder.

Ireland shamrock: original Boundary Atlas artwork.

Mexico Sun Stone:
Aztec Solar Disk Calendar.svg by Haley.Parrot, based on artwork by Jlevine13.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aztec_Solar_Disk_Calendar.svg
Source retrieved 10 November 2026:
https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/Aztec_Solar_Disk_Calendar.svg
Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Modifications: brown ink, warm stone base, circular crop, transparent exterior,
rasterized to a 256-pixel WebP.
The derivative is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license. The source SVG
and reproducible conversion are retained in scripts/symbol-sources/ and
scripts/prepare-country-symbols.mjs in the Boundary Atlas source repository.
